headline: Indian IT services posted solid top‑line growth, led by AI‑driven deals and dividend payouts.
summary: Revenue rose across the board, with TCS up 15.4% YoY and Coforge posting the strongest growth at 66.6% YoY. Profit margins improved for several firms, notably Coforge (16% EBIT) and TCS (24% operating margin). AI revenue is becoming a material contributor, highlighted by TCS, Infosys, HCLTech and Wipro. Guidance was trimmed by Infosys but remained stable for most peers.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: AI‑related revenue and deal wins lifted top‑line for TCS, Infosys, HCLTech, LTM and Wipro.

themes.title: Margin expansion
themes.detail: Operating margins rose, with TCS at 24% and Coforge achieving a 16% EBIT margin.

themes.title: Dividend focus
themes.detail: Most companies declared or raised interim dividends, supporting shareholder returns.

leaders.why: YoY revenue growth of 66.6% and raised FY27 EBIT margin guidance to 16%.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to 1‑2%.
